_comment: One place that says what has been run and what evidence exists, because the
PR body said both. It presented run W as complete at 500 of 500 and, four
screens down, said the randomised-order experiment had not been run; it said
the evidence workflow had passed and, later, that it was not green; and its
evidence section described two tranches, 1320 logs and 21 traces while the
manifest held 1820 and 22 and the release carried six assets.
Prose in several documents cannot be kept in step by hand. These numbers are
checked against the data directories and EVIDENCE_MANIFEST.sha256 by
analysis/verify_claims.py, and the documents are checked against them.

W.design: within-invocation 10x10 Williams square, randomised row order
